# Inkstone (墨观)

> Traditional Chinese color themes for editors and terminals, built from the 526-color zhongguose palette.

- Version: 0.3.4
- Extension ID: Konata9.inkstone
- License: MIT
- Site: https://konata9.github.io/inkstone/
- Chinese: https://konata9.github.io/inkstone/zh/
- Source: https://github.com/Konata9/inkstone
- Releases: https://github.com/Konata9/inkstone/releases
- Full summary: https://konata9.github.io/inkstone/llms-full.txt

## Variants

| Id | Chinese | English | Appearance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| xuanmo | 玄墨 | Xuanmo | dark |
| xuanmo-dimmed | 玄墨 Dimmed | Xuanmo Dimmed | dark |
| xuanzhi | 宣纸 | Xuanzhi | light |
| xuanzhi-dimmed | 宣纸 Dimmed | Xuanzhi Dimmed | light |
| canghai | 沧海 | Canghai | dark |
| qingci | 青瓷 | Qingci | light |

## Platforms

- Editors: VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium
- Terminals: Ghostty, Kaku / WezTerm
- Also: OpenCode V2 themes

## Install

Download `Konata9.inkstone-<version>.vsix` (and terminal archives) from GitHub Releases.
